contract.core_outcome: Activate one bounded 30-day workflow pilot per department with evidence and control
contract.approval_route: Operations, Security and People review; CEO release approval

invariants.qualifier: Only the scope in DEC-2026-08 is approved

invariants.text: Each participating department pilots one workflow with one named owner
invariants.qualifier: Only participating departments listed in the decision record

invariants.text: The pilot does not authorize production scale-up
A baseline record is required before execution
invariants.qualifier: Use the current protocol and specification

invariants.text: Restricted data requires Security approval before use
invariants.qualifier: Classification follows the current data standard

invariants.text: Results compare accepted baseline and outcome measures defined in specification v2
invariants.qualifier: No measure outside specification v2 may be claimed

invariants.text: Employees not assigned to the pilot continue the current process
invariants.qualifier: Any later change requires an approved notice

audience_evidence.statement: Board reviewers need material scope, risk, assurance, measures and decision boundary
Department Heads own workflow and owner nomination plus escalation
Workflow Owners need baseline, data gate, measure and deliverable instructions
General employees need clarity on what changes, what does not, data safety and support route

audiences.name: Board Reviewers
audiences.information_need: Material scope, risk, measures and approval boundary
audiences.language_accessibility: Concise Vietnamese, tables with text summaries
audiences.disclosure: Internal governance facts and control evidence

audiences.name: Department Heads
audiences.power_accountability: Nominate owner and ensure baseline submission
audiences.prior_knowledge: Knows pilot intent, not activation sequence
audiences.information_need: Scope, owner, deadline, dependencies and escalation
audiences.disclosure: Department scope, controls, measures and actions

audiences.name: Workflow Owners
audiences.power_accountability: Prepare baseline and execute assigned workflow
audiences.information_need: Deliverable, data gate, measure, deadline and support
audiences.disclosure: Assigned workflow details and approved controls

audiences.name: General Employees
audiences.power_accountability: Follow current process unless formally assigned
audiences.prior_knowledge: May hear that a pilot is starting
audiences.information_need: What changes, what stays, data safety and help route
audiences.desired_action: Continue current process and use the support route for questions
audiences.language_accessibility: Short Vietnamese, no internal jargon, mobile-readable
audiences.disclosure: Approved non-restricted scope and support information

actions.deliverable: Confirm the bounded scope and assurance conditions
One named workflow owner and one priority workflow
Continue current process unless assigned; route questions to support

plans.must_know: Decision, bounded scope, no-scale qualifier, data gate, baseline and measures
plans.emphasize: Material risk, assurance and separate scale decision

plans.must_know: Scope, owner nomination, baseline, data gate, measures and escalation
plans.explain: One workflow and one owner boundary

plans.must_know: Baseline deliverable, data gate, approved measures and no-scale boundary
Pilot exists, current process remains unless assigned, no scale-up and data safety
plans.emphasize: What does not change and where to ask
plans.explain: Pilot is bounded learning, not a company-wide rollout
plans.terminology_examples: Thử nghiệm có giới hạn, quy trình hiện hành, kênh hỗ trợ

variants.title_or_subject: Pilot 30 ngày: phạm vi, assurance và quyết định cần xác nhận

sections.text: Pilot 30 ngày đã được duyệt trong phạm vi một workflow và một owner tại mỗi đơn vị tham gia; chưa cho phép scale production.
sections.adaptation_rationale: Lead with decision and material boundary

sections.text: Mọi workflow phải có baseline; restricted data cần Security duyệt; kết quả chỉ dùng thước đo đã định nghĩa trong specification v2.
Đề nghị Board xác nhận phạm vi giới hạn và điều kiện assurance trước ngày 27/08/2026.

variants.title_or_subject: Kích hoạt pilot 30 ngày: xác nhận workflow và owner

sections.text: Pilot 30 ngày đã được duyệt: mỗi phòng ban tham gia chọn một workflow và một owner; chưa được tự mở rộng production.
Baseline phải hoàn tất trước khi chạy; restricted data cần Security duyệt; đo lường chỉ theo specification v2.
Mỗi Department Head xác nhận workflow và owner trước ngày 28/08/2026; vướng mắc chuyển Operations Director.
sections.adaptation_rationale: Translate the decision into owned action

variants.title_or_subject: Checklist trước khi chạy workflow pilot

sections.text: Bạn được giao một workflow trong pilot 30 ngày; phạm vi này chưa cho phép scale production.
Trước khi chạy: hoàn tất baseline, xin Security duyệt nếu có restricted data và chỉ dùng measures trong specification v2.
Nộp baseline đã hoàn tất trước ngày 01/09/2026; chuyển gap cho Operations Director.

variants.title_or_subject: Thông tin về pilot workflow 30 ngày

sections.text: Công ty đã duyệt một pilot 30 ngày có giới hạn: mỗi đơn vị tham gia chỉ thử nghiệm một workflow với một owner; đây chưa phải triển khai production toàn công ty.
sections.adaptation_rationale: Explain the bounded pilot without internal jargon

sections.text: Restricted data chỉ được dùng khi Security phê duyệt. Nhân sự không được phân công tiếp tục quy trình hiện hành.
sections.adaptation_rationale: Clarify safety and what does not change

sections.text: Hãy tiếp tục quy trình hiện tại; nếu có câu hỏi, sử dụng kênh hỗ trợ nội bộ được công bố.
sections.adaptation_rationale: Give a calm and usable next step

tests.threshold: No decision, scope, risk, qualifier or commitment drift
Correct owner, deliverable, deadline, authority and escalation
At least 90% correct must-know and no material misread
No false familiarity, stereotype or manipulative framing

tests.method: Channel, language and format usability review
tests.threshold: Usable in intended channel with no critical barrier
No contradiction or unequal material omission without authority
